THIRD AMENDMENT TO OFFICE LEASE

This Third Amendment to Office Lease (this "Amendment") is entered into as of May 18, 2026 by and between Harbor Point Realty Trust, a Maryland real estate investment trust ("Landlord"), and Vanterra Analytics, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Tenant").

RECITALS

A. Landlord and Tenant are parties to that certain Office Lease dated March 1, 2019, as amended by a First Amendment dated June 30, 2021 and a Second Amendment dated November 4, 2023 (collectively, the "Lease"), for premises consisting of approximately 18,400 rentable square feet on the sixth floor of the building located at 4400 Harbor Point Drive, Hartford, Connecticut (the "Existing Premises").

B. The Term of the Lease is scheduled to expire on August 31, 2026, and the parties wish to extend the Term, expand the Existing Premises, and modify certain other provisions.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, the parties agree as follows.

1. Definitions.

Capitalized terms used and not defined in this Amendment have the meanings given in the Lease.

2. Extension of Term.

The Term is extended for sixty (60) months, commencing September 1, 2026 and expiring August 31, 2031 (the "Extension Term"). Tenant has no further right to extend except as expressly set out in Section 8 below.

3. Expansion Premises.

Effective January 1, 2027 (the "Expansion Commencement Date"), the Premises are expanded to include approximately 6,200 rentable square feet on the seventh floor, as shown on Exhibit A-3 (the "Expansion Premises"). From and after the Expansion Commencement Date, "Premises" means the Existing Premises together with the Expansion Premises, comprising approximately 24,600 rentable square feet.

4. Base Rent.

Base Rent for the Existing Premises during the Extension Term is $38.50 per rentable square foot per year, payable in equal monthly installments of $59,033.33, increasing by three percent (3%) on each anniversary of the commencement of the Extension Term. Base Rent for the Expansion Premises begins on the Expansion Commencement Date at the same rate and escalates on the same schedule.

5. Operating Expenses; Base Year.

Tenant shall continue to pay its Proportionate Share of Operating Expenses in excess of the Base Year. The Base Year is reset to calendar year 2027 for the entire Premises. Tenant's Proportionate Share is increased to 11.4% as of the Expansion Commencement Date. Controllable Operating Expenses shall not increase by more than five percent (5%) per year on a cumulative, compounding basis.

6. Tenant Improvement Allowance.

Landlord shall provide a tenant improvement allowance of $65.00 per rentable square foot of the Expansion Premises ($403,000), disbursed against invoices for work performed under a work letter to be attached as Exhibit C. Any portion of the allowance not requisitioned by December 31, 2027 is forfeited.

7. Security Deposit.

The Security Deposit is increased from $118,000 to $155,000. Tenant shall deliver the additional $37,000 within ten (10) business days after the date of this Amendment.

8. Extension Option.

Provided no Event of Default is then continuing, Tenant has one option to extend the Term for an additional sixty (60) months at ninety-five percent (95%) of Fair Market Rental Value, exercisable by written notice given not more than fifteen (15) and not less than twelve (12) months before the expiration of the Extension Term. If the parties do not agree on Fair Market Rental Value within thirty (30) days after exercise, the determination shall be made by three appraisers under the procedure in Section 22 of the Lease.

9. Parking.

Tenant's parking allocation is increased to forty-nine (49) unreserved spaces and six (6) reserved spaces, at the then-prevailing monthly rates.

10. Condition of the Expansion Premises.

Tenant accepts the Expansion Premises in their "as is, where is" condition, and Landlord has no obligation to perform any work except as set out in the work letter.

11. Brokers.

Each party represents to the other that it has dealt with no broker in connection with this Amendment other than Coastline Tenant Advisors, whose commission Landlord shall pay under a separate agreement. Each party shall indemnify the other against claims by any other broker claiming through the indemnifying party.

12. Estoppel.

Tenant confirms that, as of the date of this Amendment, the Lease is in full force and effect, Landlord is not in default, and Tenant has no offsets, claims, or defenses against Landlord.

13. Ratification.

Except as expressly modified by this Amendment, the Lease remains in full force and effect and is ratified and confirmed. In the event of a conflict between this Amendment and the Lease, this Amendment controls.

14. Counterparts; Electronic Signatures.

This Amendment may be executed in counterparts, and signatures delivered by electronic means have the same effect as originals.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Amendment as of the date first written above.
